test_title: PYST 38: SSC GD Constable 2022 - English (Held On : 27 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym for the underlined word in the given sentence.**

Her __debonair__ combined with quick wit added to her oratory skills.
solution: The correct answer is: **Charming** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Debonair **means charming and elegant in manner. (आकर्षक और सुरुचिपूर्ण ढंग से) • It is a positive trait and is being used in a positive sense in the sentence. • **Example**: *His debonair demeanour and impeccable style made him the centre of attention at the party.* • Marked option **Charming **refers to the quality of being pleasant, delightful, or attractive, especially in a charismatic or appealing way. (सुखद, रमणीय या आकर्षक होने का गुण, विशेष रूप से करिश्माई या आकर्षक तरीके से) • **Example**: *The charming smile and witty conversation of the host welcomed guests to the event.* Therefore, **option 1** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Corpulent **means overweight or obese. (अधिक वजन या मोटापा) • **Amorous **means having or showing strong feelings of sexual attraction or love. (यौन आकर्षण या प्रेम की प्रबल भावनाएँ होना या प्रदर्शित होना) • **Churlish **means rude or bad-mannered. (असभ्य या बुरे आचरण वाला) 36:T505,The correct answer is: "**To scold someone**."
